metadata.description: sync-3 most powerful lipsync model yet, featuring native visual intelligence for professional-quality video.

info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v3
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v3 queue.

options.description: Additional Sync.so generation options. If options.sync_mode is set, it overrides the top-level sync_mode field.

sync_mode.description: Lipsync mode when audio and video durations are out of sync.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

occlusion_detection_enabled.description: Whether to detect occlusion during generation. Sync.so handles this automatically for sync-3, so this option is ignored by sync-3.
occlusion_detection_enabled.title: Occlusion Detection Enabled

prompt.description: Emotion prompt for generation. This is a Sync.so option primarily used by react-1.
prompt.title: Prompt

temperature.description: Controls how expressive lipsync can be; 0 is least expressive, 1 is most expressive. Sync.so handles this natively for sync-3, so this option is ignored by sync-3.
temperature.title: Temperature

active_speaker_detection.description: Active speaker detection configuration for videos with multiple people.

model_mode.description: Edit region for the model. This is a Sync.so option primarily used by react-1.
model_mode.title: Model Mode

sync_mode.description: Defines how to handle duration mismatches between video and audio inputs. Overrides the top-level sync_mode when provided.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

v3.description: Whether to use Sync.so's active speaker detection v3.
v3.title: V3

use_v2.description: Deprecated Sync.so option for active speaker detection v2.
use_v2.title: Use V2

bounding_boxes_url.description: URL to a JSON file containing per-frame bounding boxes.
bounding_boxes_url.title: Bounding Boxes Url

bounding_boxes.description: Per-frame bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the detected face.
bounding_boxes.title: Bounding Boxes

face_image.description: Base64 encoded face image for manual speaker selection.
face_image.title: Face Image

frame_number.description: Frame index for manual speaker selection coordinates.
frame_number.title: Frame Number

auto_detect.description: Whether to automatically detect and apply generation to the active speaker.
auto_detect.title: Auto Detect

coordinates.description: Reference point [x, y] on the speaker's face in frame_number.
coordinates.title: Coordinates

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
